LONG BEACH WORKFORCE
  INNOVATION NETWORK AGENDA
  THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 17, 2026
  4811 AIRPORT PLAZA DRIVE
  ROSI PEDERSEN ROOM, SUITE 120, 9:00 AM

Weston LaBar, Chair  Ean Hall, Member
Karin Kuo, Vice Chair  Julie Poincenot, Member
Gloria Carter, Member  Roberto Ruiz, Member
Xochitl Cobarruvias, Member  Gita Runkel, Member
John Edmond, Member  Courtney Russell, Member
Tommy Faavae, Member  Mandara Savage, Member
John Fay, Member  Kevin Smith, Member
Ken Gomez, Member  Adey Tesfaye, Member
Robyn Gordon-Peterson, Member  Henry Thomas, Member

  Members of the public have the option to email public comments
  to Karla.Corona@longbeach.gov

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-56120  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Long Beach Workforce Innovation
  Network meeting of Thursday, June 11, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-56121  Recommendation to approve the Program Year 2026-2027 Long Beach Workforce
  Innovation Network Budget.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-56122  Recommendation to approve Long Beach Workforces Innovation Network’s
  execution of an agreement, along with any required documents, subcontracts, and
  future amendments, with Long Beach Unified School District (LBUSD) to accept
  $400,000, from the LBUSD Strong Workforce Program grant. Funds will support
  the provision of workforce development services to LBUSD students for the period
  of June 1, 2026, through June 30, 2028. (Citywide)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-56123  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation regarding the 2026 Long
  Beach College and Career Expo.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 1 of 2
   LONG BEACH WORKFORCE
  INNOVATION NETWORK AGENDA
  THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 17, 2026
  4811 AIRPORT PLAZA DRIVE
  ROSI PEDERSEN ROOM, SUITE 120, 9:00 AM

5.  26-56124  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation regarding the Long Beach
  Continuum of Care (CoC) Board.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  26-56125  Recommendation to receive and file an update from the Business Engagement
  Team regarding worksite development, On-the-Job Training, job placement
  support, and Rapid Response to local layoff events.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  26-56126  Recommendation to receive and file an update on programmatic activities,
  initiatives, and strategies providing Adult, Dislocated Worker, and Youth
  participants with access to employment, education, training, and supportive
  services.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  26-56127  Recommendation to receive and file Chair’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

9.  26-56128  Recommendation to receive and file Executive Director’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Long Beach Workforce Innovation Network on non-agenda items. Each
speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Alyssa Campos, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact Workforce Development Board at (562) 570-3650.
